facts.fact: The Drum fold is a cut of shore under the cliff at the far end of the Drum, a short walk from the lodging huts along the lake.
facts.why: needed because the note names it as the exchange place; ch 25 beat places it under a cornice ledge.

facts.fact: The ransom note is charcoal on a scrap of herder's tally-hide in a clerk-like hill-script hand, pinned to the lintel of Dhanu's hut with an iron nail, Dhanu's whistle looped over the nail by its frayed thong.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires the note pinned to the door with the whistle.

facts.fact: Ila carries five sheets sewn in her coat/pattu lining (Stair, Moon, exits sheet and the new Eye sheet); Kunal knows they are on her.
facts.why: needed to stage the final question 'Where are the sheets?'

facts.fact: Kunal puts the odds that the hostages walk off the ice at about one in three if he hands over the sheets; Ila privately disagrees.
facts.why: supports technique 6 and sets up chapter 25's refusal.
